goal: Materialize existing J-Quants research features into the live Supabase production read model and current Research Workspace v2. Production means Supabase tables/migrations/RPCs or Edge Functions; local Parquet and SQLite must not be the final destination. From existing jq_market_price_daily rows, create a dedicated ex-post outcomes dataset with 1/5/20/60 trading-day forward returns and benchmark-relative excess returns. Keep outcomes separate from PIT features to prevent look-ahead leakage; use adjusted prices, deterministic session alignment, null tails when future sessions are unavailable, and no new provider calls. Backfill and refresh must be idempotent, bounded, incremental, resumable, indexed and provenance-aware. When a new Supabase migration is required, plan creation of a new migration file rather than referencing a nonexistent existing file. Connect existing shareholder-benefit/total-yield logic to live jq_market_yield publication, populating investable capital, annual benefit value, benefit yield and total yield only with reliable evidence; otherwise preserve unknown state. Expose useful fields through active Workspace v2/API and metric catalog, not only legacy/local APIs. Add tests/audits for coverage, nulls, benchmark alignment, idempotency and PIT leakage. Preserve current quota safeguards, request reserves, atomic publication and CI. Do not add unrelated data categories or unbounded fetching.
